comments.author: @globerealife
comments.text: Learning that tens of millions of unexploded cluster bombs remain underground while locals repurpose old bomb casings into house pillars and flower pots shows incredible resilience.

comments.author: @duckytips-com
comments.text: One thing I found interesting is how the idea of "Bo pen yang" reflects a slower, less stressful approach to life. I wonder which local tradition surprised you the most while making this documentary.

comments.author: @globalatlasus
comments.text: "Bo pen yang" is honestly the best mindset for stress-free living. We all need a bit of that in our lives!
